title: Golf
summary: He plays golf three or four times a week in the Bronx and carries his clubs on the road.

blocks.x: (laugh) That gives you more time to play golf?
Right. I'm out on the golf course.
How often did you play?
How often did I play?
Yeah. How often do you play when you're laying off like that?
Well, I'll say, maybe three or four times in a week, you know.
A week? Oh, yeah?
Who do you play with?
Anybody. (laugh) I go to the golf course -- you know, I don't really wait for anybody to go. I just go out there, because you can always get a game out there at the golf course.
But, it's crowded around here.
Around here? Well, I can jump right on the subway and ride to the last stop, and there's a golf course right there, you know.
Where is that?
It's Golf Course. It's at the end of Jerome Avenue subway line.
In the Bronx?
In the Bronx. Yeah. It's easy for me. I could go someplace else, but that's closer.
Yeah. Just take the subway.
All I have to do is walk across the bridge. From where I live it's about, maybe, four or five blocks, and catch the subway and ride to the last stop.
Do you ever play with Budd Johnson?
Years ago I played with Budd. But, I usually -- when I'm in California, I usually play with Joe Williams,
Oh, you do.
It's Charles Thompson who's practically a professional, isn't he?
Yeah. That's what everybody tells me. I haven't, you know -- it's been ages.
Did you ever play with him?
I played with him -- what -- maybe ten years ago. And, he was good then, and I've heard that he's supposedly a professional now. I don't know.
I think he tricks people.
Oh, yeah?
I think he lets them think he's just a piano player, and then they get a bet.
(laugh) No. I haven't run into him lately on the golf course.
But, that's one way you have of keeping fit?
Yeah. I usually go out and play. I love the game.
Do you take your clubs on the road at all?
Whenever I'm going on location, or whatever part of it that we come to that the sun is shining, or time of year that we go, or if we go to California, I take them with me.
Are there any other guys in the band that like to play?
Bobby Plater.
Bobby plays. He's about the only one.
He's about the only one?
